Description: Enemy critters can't attack your Den while you have a Guard they could legally attack instead. Guard never makes a critter unattackable or redirects attacks onto it: it protects the Den, not the team.
Can attack the turn it's played.
Ignores the first damage it would take, then pops.
Can't be attacked or targeted by the enemy until it deals damage.
Damage this critter deals also heals your Den for the same amount.
